allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Arham Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation regarding approval received from National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) for listing and trading of equity shares allotted under Arham Technologies Limited Employees Stock Option Plan, 2024.

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Arham Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 14, 2026 for allotment the equity shares upon the exercised of ESOP Options under the ATL Employee Stock Option Plan, 2024.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Arham Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Receipt of Trading approval of 48,92,000 Equity Shares of Rs. 10 each allotted on Preferential basis.
